metadata.summary: Normal operational logs only. No anomalies.

description: Null-signal adversary: attacker uses a firmware-level implant (BMC/UEFI) that exfiltrates data via out-of-band management interface. No OS logs, no EDR telemetry, no network flows visible to the OS layer. Complete action within the unobservable boundary.

expected.reason: Hard limit: firmware-level exfiltration is outside the observable boundary of OS-level forensics. Emitting BENIGN would be a false negative. ABSTAIN_EPISTEMIC with documented observability gap is correct.
